races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LORD DU GOUET continued his promising start to his career switched to hurdling when second at Fontwell 4 weeks ago and this looks an excellent opportunity for him to go one better. Eagle Warrior is considered the main threat following a perfectly encouraging first effort over hurdles in a strongly-run contest at Carlisle. Loopy Mag and Order Driven can battle it out for third spot.

  1. LORD DU GOUET (FR)
  2. EAGLE WARRIOR (IRE)
  3. LOOPY MAG (FR)

races.name: Weatherbys And Birdie Calendars 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
It looks significant that JULIUS DES PICTONS goes chasing already after his win in a Grade 1 at Aintree on his first attempt at this trip, so is preferred to Derryhassen Paddy and Fishery Lane in what is a strong event of its type.

  1. JULIUS DES PICTONS (FR)
  2. DERRYHASSEN PADDY (IRE)
  3. FISHERY LANE (FR)

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Unlike most of these, TAKEYOUTOTHEISLAND brings an unexposed profile to the table so he's selected to make a successful reappearance. De Deli Counter is fit and in form so will doubtless be popular, with Wind Your Neck In also of some interest with a reappearance under his belt.

  1. TAKEYOUTOTHEISLAND (IRE)
  2. DE DELI COUNTER
  3. WIND YOUR NECK IN (IRE)

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
races.verdict:
RATEMENOW picked up where he left off in the spring when finding only a handicap debutant too good at Market Rasen on his reappearance and is the percentage call to go one better on the back of a breathing operation. Fourofakind showed more promise than the bare result suggests back from another break at Carlisle on his most recent outing and needs a close look having fallen a long way in the weights, with stable-switcher Je Mr Dawson also of interest.

  1. RATEMENOW (IRE)
  2. FOUROFAKIND (IRE)
  3. JE MR DAWSON (FR)

races.name: B K Racing Long Distance Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WAL BUCK'S was unlucky to bump into one on his return here last month and shades the vote over Betterforeveryone, who has plenty going for him. My Gift To You is best of the others.

  1. WAL BUCK'S (FR)
  2. BETTERFOREVERYONE
  3. MY GIFT TO YOU (IRE)

races.name: QuinnBet Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
SCAIRP DUBH had excuses here last time so is well worth another chance to confirm the promise of his chase debut win over C&D in May. Drop Kick built up a solid record over hurdles and he's likely to make a chaser, so is feared most ahead of Kinbara Firstdraft and Halpha Soleil.

  1. SCAIRP DUBH
  2. DROP KICK (IRE)
  3. KINBARA FIRSTDRAFT (IRE)

races.name: QuinnBet Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MAX POTENTIAL held every chance when falling at the last on his outing in Irish points in March and, having subsequently been purchased for a whopping £280,000, he makes obvious appeal on his Rules debut, especially with good-value claimer Rian Corcoran in the saddle. Rio Blue is in top hands and also ticks plenty of boxes on paper, so warrants respect, while Yorgunnarock has achieved the most of those with Rules experience as things stand.

  1. MAX POTENTIAL
  2. RIO BLUE (IRE)
  3. YORGUNNAROCK

races.name: Dandara Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
NO WALKOVER looked a very useful prospect in bumpers and with excuses on account of underfoot conditions when well held at Newbury on his final outing, David Pipe's charge is fancied to make a bold bid now hurdling on return. Blinded By Grace and Bob Bishop are other hurdling newcomers to note, with Jevon also commanding a check in the betting given the stable he represents.

  1. NO WALKOVER
  2. BLINDED BY GRACE
  3. BOB BISHOP

races.name: Dandara Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
DIAMOND STREET displayed plenty of ability on each of his 2 starts in bumpers last season, scoring on debut at Doncaster prior to finishing a solid fifth at Newbury in March. He has plenty about him physically to suggest he will make his mark over hurdles and he earns the vote. Quickkick's tendency to pull hard hasn't stopped steady progress to date and he's feared, with Poets Express and Moments In Time another couple of interesting types from bumpers.

  1. DIAMOND STREET (IRE)
  2. QUICKKICK (IRE)
  3. POETS EXPRESS (IRE)

races.name: Golwg Gwendraeth Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A very strong race for its type with 3 of the first 4 home from the Supreme lining up, including the winner OLD PARK STAR and runner-up Sober Glory. Both will make chasers with Old Park Star (who is currently the clear favourite for the Arkle) taken to come out on top again.

  1. OLD PARK STAR (IRE)
  2. SOBER GLORY (IRE)
  3. BARON NOIR (IRE)

races.name: Edwina Jones 80th Birthday Celebrations Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
WANNABE was set to be beaten only by a subsequent winner when departing at the last over C&D on chase bow/return so looks a big player off the same mark. Potential improvers Manhattan Valley and Walk Tall are feared most.

  1. WANNABE (IRE)
  2. MANHATTAN VALLEY (FR)
  3. WALK TALL (IRE)

races.name: Support Your Oncourse Bookmakers Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for MERRY AWAY, who made a successful Rules bow in a Warwick bumper back in March and enhanced his form further when fourth in Grade 2 company at the Aintree Festival next time. He can make the smooth transition to hurdling at the expense of Valiant Soldier, who promises to be suited by this step up to 2½m. Point-winner Doagh rounds off the shortlist.

  1. MERRY AWAY (IRE)
  2. VALIANT SOLDIER (IRE)
  3. DOAGH (IRE)

races.name: 3A's Leisure Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NO BOUNDARIES has way more potential than most in this and with his yard amongst the winners, Jane Williams' 4-y-o gets the nod to build on his promising return. For Old Times Sake should be all the sharper for his return so he can be the one to provide most resistance, with recent-winner Wispit Twob completing the shortlist with Bowen retaining the partnership.

  1. NO BOUNDARIES (FR)
  2. FOR OLD TIMES SAKE (IRE)
  3. WISPIT TWOB (IRE)

races.name: Welsh Cottage Christmas Cakes Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
SEASETT shaped encouragingly on first start for new connections when runner-up at Hexham in late-August (had breathing operation) and given another try over the larger obstacles, Mickey Bowen's 8-y-o could well be the answer. He gets the nod over Pooroldmackley, who was in good form prior to his most recent effort so can get back on track. Unleash The Beast rounds off the shortlist on return/chasing debut.

  1. SEASETT
  2. POOROLDMACKLEY (IRE)
  3. UNLEASH THE BEAST (IRE)

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
TREDEGAR SQUARE won't be inconvenienced by 6f given how he's shaped so far and is taken to build on his promising winning debut at the second attempt here. Brave Country is the obvious threat, though Livorno may well take a big step forward this time.

  1. TREDEGAR SQUARE
  2. BRAVE COUNTRY (IRE)
  3. LIVORNO

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ANGEL FOOTSTEPS has been off the track since finishing second at Redcar in the spring but she represents a good yard and in receipt of weight from the rest in an ordinary-looking novice, she could be the answer. Amandari needs to learn how to settle but he's certainly in the right hands, with King's Flight and Tuxedo Black both appealing newcomers.

  1. ANGEL FOOTSTEPS
  2. AMANDARI (IRE)
  3. KING'S FLIGHT

races.name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Nursery
races.verdict:
NIGHTBLOOM improved markedly for the step up to this trip last time and, with the form having been franked, she looks well capable of following up at the expense of a couple dropping in grade. Divine Whisper should find this level more to her liking, while Lady Blanche has strong form to her name if fit enough to do herself justice on first outing since May.

  1. NIGHTBLOOM (IRE)
  2. DIVINE WHISPER
  3. LADY BLANCHE (IRE)

races.name: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Nursery
races.verdict:
DIVINE RHYTHM may well have gone backwards from an encouraging debut last time, but a couple of in-frame efforts mean he can make this quick switch to nurseries. In top hands switched to all-weather, he gets the verdict over Q T Boy, who went close to doubling his tally at Bath recently and now makes his all-weather debut. The experienced Global Success rounds off the shortlist.

  1. DIVINE RHYTHM (IRE)
  2. Q T BOY
  3. GLOBAL SUCCESS (IRE)

races.name: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
STERLING COOPER improved markedly when third at Newmarket in September, shaping as if this step up to 1m will suit, and another step forward should see him off the mark. Lady Margo ran too green when fourth on debut over C&D last month but should be sharper for the experience, while Gilder Roy can prove a threat if coping with the drop back in trip.

  1. STERLING COOPER (IRE)
  2. LADY MARGO (IRE)
  3. GILDER ROY

races.name: Try Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Handicap
races.verdict:
PALLADAS looked an exciting prospect when winning his first 2 starts on all-weather, including over C&D, and can resume his progress back up to 1m faced with more exposed rivals. Having been gelded, Princling shaped encouragingly when an unlucky third at Ascot last time and is another 3-y-o to note, while Hard Endeavor has a C&D win to his name and should be suited by the drop back to this trip.

  1. PALLADAS
  2. PRINCLING
  3. HARD ENDEAVOR (FR)

races.name: Unibet Interactive Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ZACHARY HICKES is the least exposed of these and found further progress when justifying strong market confidence at Wolverhampton 36 days ago. He's up 3 lb but should have more to offer so is fancied to defy the rise with the step up to 2m likely to suit. Tarbat Ness has been in excellent form with 4 wins this year and drew clear at Southwell, so is feared most.

  1. ZACHARY HICKES
  2. TARBAT NESS
  3. SQUIRE DANAGHER

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Handicap
races.verdict:
ENACTING shaped very well on recent comeback run and is taken to prove too good for more exposed rivals. Caragio has won twice at this track in recent weeks and moved through the race as if still on a winnable mark when second at Newmarket 18 days ago so is set to prove the biggest danger, while Chalk Mountain will be well suited by a well-run race and can figure if getting the breaks.

  1. ENACTING (IRE)
  2. CARAGIO (IRE)
  3. CHALK MOUNTAIN

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap
races.verdict:
CROWN OF CROWNS is a lightly-raced filly who built on debut promise when winning a Southwell novice in October, and whilst she still showed some greenness that day, she's bred to stay well and can make a winning handicap debut. Snooker Mccrew is thriving so is hard to discount, though does have stamina to prove, while Midnight Media looks capable of going well once again.

  1. CROWN OF CROWNS
  2. SNOOKER MCCREW
  3. MIDNIGHT MEDIA

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Auction Maiden
races.verdict:
RAYASTAR was learning on the job and surely would have been placed but for blowing the start when fourth in a 6f maiden here on debut 3 weeks ago. Looking sure to be suited by this step up in trip, he can build on that effort and come out on top. Coloursofthewind also made a promising first start when third over C&D recently and along with Jezzie Bea and Celtic Comet heads the dangers.

  1. RAYASTAR (IRE)
  2. COLOURSOFTHEWIND (IRE)
  3. JEZZIE BEA (USA)

races.name: Dundalk Stadium Gift Vouchers Available Online Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
THE BEAR TRAP belatedly confirmed the promise of his stable debut effort when capitalising on his reduced mark with a bit to spare over C&D 7 days ago. He could be worth siding with to follow up under a penalty in an open race. Fellow last-time-out winner Pocket Jacks, Jazzy Dancer and Strikepoint are others to consider.

  1. THE BEAR TRAP (IRE)
  2. POCKET JACKS (IRE)
  3. JAZZY DANCER (IRE)

races.name: Dundalk Stadium Gift Vouchers Available Online Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Those at the head of the weights make most appeal, with PALLATINE HILLS taken to reverse C&D form with Jazzit from 3 weeks ago on these better terms. Four Blondes is also considered.

  1. PALLATINE HILLS (IRE)
  2. JAZZIT
  3. BLUE ANTHEM

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Nursery Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
ROCK ON JOHNNY left his previous efforts well behind when winning on handicap debut here just 5 days ago and can defy the quick turnaround under a good-value 10-lb claimer. Mutamarid Lsk is feared most after improving since being gelded and switched to all-weather, while Hazy Sky is the type to do better in handicaps and would be of strong interest if well supported.

  1. ROCK ON JOHNNY (IRE)
  2. MUTAMARID LSK (IRE)
  3. HAZY SKY (IRE)

races.name: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Maiden
races.verdict:
STOOKED can't have been right at Roscommon last time so provided Ger Lyons' filly is ready to roll back from a 3-month break, she's fancied to go one better than on her first couple of outings in July. Otsana took a step forward when runner-up over 7f here a fortnight ago so she may emerge as the main threat, while Joseph O'Brien looks to have a strong hand and Brise Fraiche looks the best of his quartet.

  1. STOOKED (IRE)
  2. OTSANA (IRE)
  3. BRISE FRAICHE

races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict:
GO OUT is a better performer on all-weather than turf and, with the booking of Colin Keane catching the eye, he is taken to resume winning ways in an open handicap. Final Boss is feared most back up to 1m after improving here last time, while Phoenix Pairc is also respected with Billy Lee back in the saddle.

  1. GO OUT (FR)
  2. FINAL BOSS (IRE)
  3. PHOENIX PAIRC (IRE)

races.name: Safer Gambling Week 2026 Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
RHAPSODIC is bound to improve on her debut sixth at Leopardstown last month so Dermot Weld's filly is put forward as the answer with this marked step up in trip holding no fears. Serendipia has plenty of decent efforts to her name so she could be the one to give the selection most to think about on all-weather bow. Blue Nasturtium rounds off the shortlist.

  1. RHAPSODIC
  2. SERENDIPIA (IRE)
  3. BLUE NASTURTIUM (IRE)

races.name: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
MEDIEVAL NIGHT has posted several solid efforts in defeat this season and, with the step back up in trip likely to suit, is taken to finally shed his maiden tag from a career-low rating. Past C&D winner Syosset is feared most after a good spell over hurdles and an excuse latest, while Prada's World can also get involved after a good recent run.

  1. MEDIEVAL NIGHT (IRE)
  2. SYOSSET (IRE)
  3. PRADA'S WORLD (IRE)
